# BananaSplit

> Split expenses with friends. The expense tracking layer for humans and AI agents.

BananaSplit tracks shared expenses across vacations, roommates, couples, and group events. This documentation covers the CLI, agent integrations, and QR Code API.

## CLI

Install: `curl -fsSL https://github.com/teotti/banana-cli/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh`
Sign in: `banana login`
Check balances: `banana balance`
Add expense: `banana expenses add --title "Dinner" --amount 42 --currency EUR --paid-by me --split me=21 --split Ana=21`

Use `--json` for structured output. Use names instead of IDs for currencies, groups, and people.

## Agent Integration

Install skill: `npx skills add teotti/banana-cli --skill banana --global`
Or after CLI: `banana skill install`

Supported: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, opencode, any shell-enabled agent.

## QR Code API

Base URL: https://bananasplit.net/api/qr-code
No auth required. Stateless. 60 requests/minute.

Types: url, wifi, vcard, email, sms, text
Formats: svg, png, json

Example: `curl "https://bananasplit.net/api/qr-code?type=url&url=https://example.com&format=svg"`
